ledger_paragraph: O-007 remainder subunit LOCAL-ONLY at remote HEAD cbee8813d (clean worktree; all five baselines fresh sandbox reads, local src/ confirmed divergent and untouched). Two surgical candidates: foundationTemplateModel allowlist +17 fields (hyperlink, beautify_data_url, pricing settings, 12 authored rate inputs) with a sanitizeTemplateCustomerPricing gate at BOTH snapshot and apply time - the applied-tier SELECTION round-trips ({applied,tier_number}) while the computed sell snapshot is stripped (verbatim carry would show a stale source price on a different design; save recomputes when applied===true); malformed customer_pricing and non-record/assemblies still fail closed. Deliberate exclusions documented: client_name/customer_id/estimate_number/pricing_engine never enter templates (customer/quote identity + engine context must not transplant), totals/delivery snapshot/receipts stay record-scoped. Accepted-design round-trip needs no code: item reinforcement_design+calculation_version are deep-cloned verbatim (internal mat/tie ids are item data, not component ids) - proven deep-equal with fresh component ids. Evidence: 16/16 esbuild+react-test-renderer cases, 6/6 real-DOM Chrome cases at 1280/390 with stub entities and zero external requests, diffs +10 page/+74 model lines, syntax clean. No remote write/checkpoint/deploy/business records/paid AI.
